Services

Installation of commercial glazing, windows and doors in Winnipeg and across Manitoba.

Curtain wall

We install aluminum curtain wall systems on new buildings and additions. Layout, anchors, framing, glass and seals are done by the same crew, so the wall is plumb, tight and ready for inspection.

  • Layout and anchor installation
  • Mullions, pressure plates and caps
  • Glass, spandrel and panel infill
  • Perimeter seals and air/vapour barrier tie-in

+ See photos

Storefront & entrances

Storefront framing and aluminum entrances for retail, offices and apartment buildings. We set the frames, hang and adjust the doors, and leave the entrance working the way it should.

  • Aluminum storefront framing
  • Entrance doors, closers and hardware
  • Vestibules and apartment building entrances
  • Glass replacement and re-glazing

+ See photos

Office partitions

Interior glazed partitions for offices and tenant fit-ups: framed systems, frameless glass fronts and glass doors. We work clean in finished spaces and around other trades.

  • Glass office fronts and meeting rooms
  • Framed and frameless systems
  • Glass doors, pulls and hardware
  • Straight, angled and segmented layouts

+ See photos

Commercial windows

Aluminum and fiberglass window installation for commercial, multi-family and heritage buildings, new construction and retrofit.

  • Aluminum and fiberglass windows
  • New construction and retrofit
  • Heritage building window replacement
  • Flashing, insulation and sealing

+ See photos

Apartment PVC windows

PVC window replacement for apartment blocks and townhouses, done as one job for the whole building. The windows come from our own shop in Winnipeg, so sizes and delivery are under our control.

  • Whole-building window replacement
  • Apartment blocks and townhouses
  • Flashing, insulation and sealing
  • PVC windows fabricated in our own shop

Hollow metal doors & hardware

We install hollow metal frames, doors and finish hardware on commercial and multi-family projects. Labour-only packages are welcome — send us the door schedule and we will price it.

  • Hollow metal frames and doors
  • Finish hardware installed to the hardware schedule
  • Fire-rated openings
  • Labour-only installation for suppliers and general contractors
